names.note: Name page 14292 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Николай (Порецкий), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Николая пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE and no folder in this corpus carries «Порецкий» in any form.

death.note: The day line closes «(1933)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Николая пресвитера (1933).»

attestations.note: The day's ninth and last entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page behind it. THE TWO HALVES OF THE SOURCE GRADE HIM DIFFERENTLY: the line says «пресвитера», presbyter, and the name page «протоиерей», archpriest. `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are taken, those being the words the locale packs carry; «протоиерей» is recorded here and nowhere else, an `office` string absent from the four packs being a translation a reader may not invent. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
